name: Kaas Plateau (Kaas Pathar)
tagline: A UNESCO World Natural Heritage wildflower plateau — easy walking, timed entry
seoTitle: Kaas Plateau Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Kaas Plateau near Satara — UNESCO wildflower season, timed entry booking, and what makes this different from a real trek.
dataNote: This is a walking/nature destination rather than a technical trek — flat, easy terrain. Species counts for the plateau vary widely across sources (175 vs. 850+) depending on whether flowering plants specifically or all flora broadly is being counted; we haven't resolved this discrepancy.

seasons.label: Late Aug – Oct
seasons.sub: Wildflower bloom window — peak is usually September

seasons.label: Rest of year
seasons.sub: Plateau is far less scenic outside bloom season

routeOptions.name: Plateau walking trails
routeOptions.notes: Flat, marked walking paths — not a strenuous trek. The main effort is getting the timed entry slot right during bloom season.

permits.name: Timed entry ticket
permits.where: Online booking recommended, especially for weekends
permits.notes: Entry is regulated with timed slots and vehicle restrictions during flowering season to protect the endemic ecosystem.

safety.intro: Kaas is low-risk by trekking standards — the main practical issue is securing an entry slot, not physical difficulty.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Book your timed entry slot online in advance during September weekends — it sells out
Check current bloom status before traveling — the peak window is short and weather-dependent

cards.title: On the trail
items: Stay strictly on marked paths — many species here are endemic and protected
Don't pick flowers or step off boardwalks/paths

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Very safe and accessible solo — a nature walk more than a trek
Combine with a Satara-area day trip for a fuller itinerary

items.name: Printed/digital copy of your timed-entry booking
